items.title: Stock Market Crash LIVE: Sensex off 900 pts from day's high, Nifty below 22,500; India VIX jumps 7%
items.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates Friday: In the broader markets, the Nifty MidCap and the Nifty SmallCap fell 2.54 per cent and 3.45 per cent, respectively

items.title: Microcap 250 index slips 2%; Aeroflex, Rallis, Bluestone slide up to 8%
items.description: In the past five trading days, the Nifty Microcap 250 index declined 7% and quoted at its lowest level since June 12, 2026.

items.title: Swiggy slumps 15% to new low as Q2 below expectations, analysts cut targets
items.description: Analysts said that Swiggy is growing slower than Eternal now on both food delivery and quick commerce.

items.title: Zetwerk shares debut at 5% premium over IPO price, beat expectations
items.description: Zetwerk, a technology-led global manufacturing platform, saw just 3.06 times bids for its IPO, which was available for bidding from October 15 till October 19.

items.title: Bonfiglioli Transmissions shares list at par to IPO price despite 46x bids
items.description: Bonfiglioli Transmissions' share price is listed at ₹586 on the BSE and the National Stock Exchange, the same as the IPO price.

items.title: Sahajanand Medical shares make positive debut, list at 8% premium
items.description: Sahajanand Medical Technologies' debut was broadly in line with grey market premium (GMP) indications, which had pointed to listing gains of around 8 per cent.

items.title: Tonbo Imaging shares make strong debut, list at 66% premium over IPO price
items.description: On the BSE, the stock listed at ₹1,162, a premium of 66 per cent, while on the NSE, the stock made its debut at ₹1,160, a premium of 65.71 per cent.

items.title: Havells India gains nearly 2% after Q2 results; brokerages split on outlook
items.description: The company reported a 9.72 per cent year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit to ₹349.22 crore in the September quarter of FY27, helped by revenue growth.

items.title: Nifty set to log 3rd longest technical correction; shallowest in history
items.description: The Nifty on Friday is set to register its longest time-wise technical correction (trading below long-term average) since Jan 2012, totalling 160 days. Index is below its 200-DMA since Feb 27, 2026.

items.title: Stocks to watch: eMudhra, Infosys, Swiggy, HPCL, Havells, Sun Pharma, JSL
items.description: Stocks to watch today: eMudhra, Infosys, Swiggy, HPCL, Havells, Sun Pharma, Jindal Stainless, Rallis India, Infosys, JSW Steel, Tech Mahindra, among others, will be in focus today.

items.title: Asian shares slip as tech rout boosts bonds, dents rate hike bets
items.description: MSCI's broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares excluding Japan fell 0.3% on Friday, bringing its weekly loss to 2.7% and marking a fourth straight week in the red
